_about: App Store screenshots for the Easer app, in English and Spanish. EaserStoreScreenshots.swift takes each screen by the name on the left; scripts/app-store-frames.py lays out each frame. The listing recruits pros: pay before accepting, jobs within their distance, paid after every job. Photos are real jobs from bookings cleared for marketing (Terms on or after 2026-10-20), metadata removed, each used once. The referral figures come from EASER_REFERRAL_POLICY (scripts/test-easer-native-app.mjs checks them). Owner approves the words.
